stepAnswer: Total momentum before = Total momentum after
stepExplanation: Conservation of momentum applies to all collisions: $$m_1u_1 + m_2u_2 = m_1v_1 + m_2v_2$$. In an elastic collision, both momentum and kinetic energy are conserved, but we only need momentum conservation here.
stepBody: We have information about the masses and velocities before and after collision. What principle allows us to find the unknown velocity?
